working_definition: Early-dataset (0-24h APF) cluster named 'T3' by the authors (Kurmangaliyev et al. 2020, GSE156455 metadata_early subtype); composed primarily of immature T3 cells of the developing optic lobe/eye.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature secondary neuron that is a precursor to an adult T3 neuron (Kurmangaliyev et al., 2020).

justification: Authors name this early (0-24h APF) cluster T3; the cells are developing T3 neurons, so FBbt's immature form of the T3 neuron, added for this dataset (FBbt #2216, release 2026-11-02).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature secondary neuron that is a precursor to an adult T neuron (Hormann et al., 2020).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Parent of the new immature T3 neuron term (used until FBbt #2216 was released).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: T neuron with its soma posteriorly adjacent to the gap between the medulla and lobula plate and a cell body fiber that projects along the proximal surface of the medulla before branching in the second optic chiasm (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Shinomiya et al., 2019). One branch forms a bushy, fine, terminal arborization in medulla layer M9 and the other forms a terminal arborization in lobula layers 2 and 3 with mix of bleb-type and fine terminal branches (Morante and Desplan, 2008; Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It seems to be capable of both glutamatergic and GABAergic neurotransmission.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature/adult term; cells are 0-24h APF immature neurons.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00053666 'immature T3 neuron' (exact match).
